spans.s:
गह् गह् (connected with गाह्), cl. 10. P.
गहयति, -यितुम्, to be thick or imper-
vious (?); to enter deeply into.

गाह् गाह्, cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) गाहते,
-ति, जगाहे, गाहिष्यते, अगाहिष्ट, गा-
हितुम् or गाढुम्, to dive into, bathe in, plunge
into, penetrate, enter deeply into; roam, range, rove;
to be absorbed in (with acc.); to hide one's self in:
Caus. गाहयति, -यितुम्, अजीगहत्: Desid. जिगा-
हिषते and जिघाक्षते: Intens. जागाह्यते and
जागाढि.
गह, अस्, m. a cave; a forest (?); [cf. दुर्-गह.]

गाह, अस्, ई, अम्, diving into, bathing; (अस्), m.
depth, interior, innermost recess.

गहन, अस्, आ, अम्, deep, dense, thick, imper-
vious, impenetrable, inexplicable, hard to be under-
stood, inaccessible; (अम्), n. an abyss, a depth; an
inaccessible place, a hiding-place, a thicket, a wood,
impenetrable darkness; a cave; pain, distress; [cf.
गभीर.]
—गहन-त्व, अम्, n. density; imper-
viousness, impenetrability.
—गहन-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, having hiding-places or thickets.

गाहन, अम्, n. the act of diving into, plunging,
bathing, penetrating.

गहनाय, nom. A. गहनायते, -यितुम्, to have
treacherous intentions towards another, (originally, to
lie hid, lie in wait for a person in a secret place, lie
in ambush.)

गहीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a cave or a thicket;
deep, difficult of access, impervious.
गह्मन्, अ, n., Ved. depth; [cf. गम्भन्.]

गह्वर, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (related to गभीर and
गहन), deep, impervious, impenetrable; (अम्), n.
an abyss, a depth; water; a hiding-place, a thicket;
a wood; an impenetrable secret, a riddle; a cave,
cavern; hypocrisy; weeping; a deep sigh; (ई), an
abyss, a cave, a cavern, a grotto, a recess in a rock
or mountain &c.; (अस्), m. an arbour, a bower.
—गह्वरे-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being at the bot-
tom or lowest depths, being in the secret recesses.

गह्वरित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a hiding-place,
concealed.

गाहनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be dived into or pene-
trated.

गाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, bathed in, plunged into, im-
mersed, entered deeply into, penetrated; shaken,
agitated, destroyed.

गाहितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who plunges into water,
a bather, diver; one who penetrates; shaking,
agitating; destroying, a destroyer.
